scores.evidence: Nothing goes into the template until it runs in all three.
scores.rationale: Phases build from trust/identity and artifact contract up to template, progressive delivery, fleet and scale, each gated on a proven exit check of the prior phase.

scores.evidence: a merge to `main` in one real, low-risk, stateless service... `/version` endpoint in production returning the new commit SHA.
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is a real thin end-to-end slice in production with rollback tested, before any templates or features.

scores.evidence: Repo topology (very expensive to reverse) | Keep the existing polyrepo... | More than 25% of PRs need coordinated changes across services
scores.rationale: Table lists irreversible decisions with defaults and quantified flip conditions, with no silent assumptions.

scores.evidence: Tasks (widest → narrowest): 1. Trust and identity model... Every later pipeline inherits this.
scores.rationale: Each phase explicitly orders tasks widest to narrowest with leaf work last, and the rationale is specific.

scores.evidence: OIDC to registry (no static keys); branch protection on `main`; Argo CD SSO; human-gated prod promotion
scores.rationale: Security has concrete content in every phase, starting at Phase 0, through enforcement and CVE remediation.

scores.evidence: one Grafana board shows commit-to-prod lead time and deploy success/failure... Loki... alerts: Argo CD sync failure
scores.rationale: Observability is concrete in Phase 0 and in each later phase.

scores.evidence: Image referenced by digest, never `:latest`; desired state lives in Git
scores.rationale: Reproducibility such as digest pinning, pinned actions, lockfiles, and replayable migrations appears in every phase.

scores.evidence: Rollback by config-repo revert, tested in prod; ephemeral runners (no snowflake build box)
scores.rationale: Failure handling appears in every phase: rollback, warm pools, fail-closed scanner, auto-rollback, HA, DR game-day.

scores.evidence: N/A. The system has no model, no retrieval, and no autonomous agent making decisions.
scores.rationale: Plan explicitly declares the AI layer not applicable and adds no AI components.

scores.evidence: Developer portal (Backstage...): Pull forward when service discovery or ownership questions become a weekly incident-response bottleneck
scores.rationale: Ten deferred items each have a concrete pull-forward condition.
